name: pass-the-aux
description: Pass the Aux — a small-party DJ mixer for the rest of us. Two decks, collaborative crate, crowd suggestions over QR, and extended search across self-hosted remote record stores. Layered TypeScript with near-zero runtime deps.

scripts.dev: npm run build && (trap 'kill 0' EXIT; tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput & node --watch server.ts)
